name: Retrieval Wand
pages: Right click golems to retrieve golem back into inventory, as if the player right clicks it by empty hand.$(br2)Right click in air to retrieve all golems in a radious of 20 blocks.$(br2)Shift right click to retrieve golems the player points to, up to 64 blocks far.

When L2Backpack is present:$(br2)When player has Ender Backpack equipped, golems will be retrieved to ender backpack.$(br2)When player has their own dimensional backpack in inventory or ender backpack, golem with respective config color will be retrieved to dimensional backpack.
